name: finance_bench-8192
description: finance_bench-8192 is a finance-focused benchmark designed to evaluate language models on tasks requiring long-context understanding in financial domains (the name implies support for 8,192-token contexts). It measures models' ability to answer finance-related questions, summarize documents, and reason over extended financial texts. The benchmark is intended to stress long-context comprehension and domain-specific accuracy for financial applications.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (for QA) and ROUGE-like overlap metrics for summarization
reputation: A niche, domain-specific dataset on Hugging Face used by researchers exploring long-context and finance tasks, with limited mainstream adoption.
